metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1987 · Where Is the Friend's House?
metas.description: Eight-year-old Ahmed has mistakenly taken his friend Mohammad's notebook. He wants to return it, or else his friend will be expelled from school. The boy determinedly sets out to find Mohammad's home in the neighbouring village.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1984 · A Christmas Carol
metas.description: A bitter old miser who rationalizes his uncaring nature learns real compassion when three spirits visit him on Christmas Eve.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1988 · The Bear
metas.description: An orphan bear cub hooks up with an adult male as they try to dodge human hunters.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1975 · The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix
metas.description: Reodor Felgen decides that he will enter a car race to defeat his former friend who has stolen his plans for a car.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1970 · Scrooge
metas.description: A musical retelling of Charles Dickens' classic novel about an old bitter miser taken on a journey of self-redemption, courtesy of several mysterious Christmas apparitions.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1973 · Three Wishes for Cinderella
metas.description: Life changes dramatically for a Czech housemaid when the family coachman gives her three magical hazelnuts.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1974 · The Year Without a Santa Claus
metas.description: When a weary and discouraged Santa Claus considers skipping his Christmas Eve run one year, Mrs. Claus and his elves set out to change his mind.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 1978 · Happy Days
metas.description: A mid-aged couple with 6 kids who are running a pickle shop gets divorced with 3 kids each. The family members find each other years later with a funny story.
A musical retelling of the American Revolution's political struggle in the Continental Congress to declare independence.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1983 · The Ballad of Narayama
metas.description: In a poor 19th century rural Japanese village, everyone who reaches the age of 70 has to climb a nearby mountain to die. An elderly woman is reaching close to her cut-off age during her last days with her family.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1977 · Smiling Eyes
metas.description: A couple who dreamed of having a son had five daughters in a row. When girls reach the age of marriage, there are moments that make them laugh and sometimes make them sad.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1975 · Our Family
metas.description: A love story between a poor man and a rich girl. The rich girl's father tries to prevent their marriage and he declares a war against the poor boy's family.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1987 · The Story of Hachikō
metas.description: The true story about a dog's loyalty to its master, even after his death.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1980 · Little Lord Fauntleroy
metas.description: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental Lord, who oversees the trust.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1980 · The King and the Mockingbird
metas.description: A chimney sweep and a shepherdess seek to escape from the clutches of a tyrannical king.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1977 · Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
metas.description: A poor otter family risks everything for the chance to win the cash prize of a talent contest for Christmas.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1974 · That's Entertainment!
metas.description: Various MGM stars from yesteryear present their favorite musical moments from the studio's 50-year history.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1972 · Sounder
metas.description: The oldest son of a loving and strong family of black sharecroppers comes of age in the Depression-era South after his father is imprisoned for stealing food.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1987 · A Muppet Family Christmas
metas.description: Fozzie Bear surprises his mother on Christmas Eve by bringing the entire Muppet gang to her farm to celebrate the holidays.
